mira: Quick flag — just finished initial quant bring-up for hera13b (int8). Latency down ~18% p50, cost per 1M tokens down ~22%. But longform recall slice (search-rewrite, 8k contexts) shows ~4.6% drop in exact-match vs fp16.
leo: Can you paste the short metrics? numbers help decisioning.
mira: Sure — p50: 120ms -> 98ms, p95: 540 -> 560 (small tail bump), cost/1M tokens: $125 -> $98, EM on longform: 62.4% -> 57.8%. sample size 5k.
thomas: hmm p95 increase is worrying. was kv-cache warm?
mira: tests were cold-starts mixed with warm. KV cache reduced token work for repeat contexts by ~30% in separate run. The regression persists in warm runs too (~3.9% EM drop).
anika: Do we have human eval or quality signal beyond EM (e.g., BLEU/Rouge or instruction-following)?
mira: We ran ROUGE-L and a semantic-similarity lift: rouge -2 down 3.2 pts, embedding cosine mean down 0.012. Human spot-check (200 samples) flagged hallucination rate up from 3.5% -> 6.1% on the worst prompts.
leo: So tradeoff is clear: cost + perf vs fidelity on longform. Product owners will care about hallucination spike.
thomas: Proposed mitigations: 1) try mixed-precision per-layer (int8 for attention + fp16 residuals), 2) run int6 pilot (if runtime supports), 3) hybrid routing for "high-risk" endpoints.
manika: +1 to routing. We should define what "high-risk" means — maybe queries > 2k tokens or routes with high recall weight.
mira: Agreed. I sketched a quick unit econ for routing: assume 100k daily queries, avg 1.2k tokens. Baseline fp16 cost/day ≈ $15k, all-int8 cost/day ≈ $11.7k. If we route 20% of traffic (high-risk) to fp16 and 80% to int8, cost/day ≈ $13.3k and expected overall EM loss ~0.8% (weighted).
leo: That math sounds promising. Also consider canary: 5% traffic to int8 for early rollout, monitor hallucination and tail latency.
thomas: I'll set up a canary in Console: route flag hera13b.hybrid_canary = {int8: 5%, fp16: 95%}. Add observability alerts: hallucination_rate > 4% OR EM drop > 1.5% triggers rollback.
mira: Example eval command I used:```bash
ri eval run --model hera13b-int8 --suite longform-search-rewrite --samples 5000 --kv-cache warm --out results/int8_longform.json
```
leo: Can you drop the results JSON to the gdrive? I'll run paired comparisons and bootstrap significance.
mira: Uploaded results + human notes: https://drive.redwood/projects/hera13b/int8_longform_notes.md
anika: Product ask: if routing is implemented, we'll need a deterministic way to tag "safety-critical" traffic. Proposing header X-LLM-SLA: "safety=1" from product gateway.
thomas: Ops question — will Dedicated customers on private infra get the same int8 runtime? Could be differences in kernels.
mira: Kernel parity TBD. We saw slight perf variation on A100 vs H100. We'll add per-region perf profile to model catalog before GA.
leo: Next steps (owners): mira -> run int6 sweep (2k samples quick), thomas -> create canary + alerts, me (leo) -> bootstrap significance and cost-sim, anika -> confirm product tagging and GTN impact.
mira: Timeline: quick sweep by EOD tomorrow, canary ready early next week.
ops-bot: Deploy scheduled: canary route flag will be created in Console by thomas on 2026-03-22 09:00 UTC.
anika: One more ask — add a short note for GTN: recommended default for large retrieval endpoints = hybrid routing 80/20 int8/fp16 with canary.
leo: I'll draft the GTN blurb and include unit econ table and rollback triggers.
mira: Thanks all — will ping when int6 sweep completes. :thumbsup:
